title: Normalized strict tower limit and direct-image data
statement: Let $A$ be a small ringed-site corner with a chosen unbounded derived category and derived tensor presentation [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-square-presentation]. Define $\operatorname{Tow}(A)=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}},\operatorname{Mod}(A))$, postcomposition on diagrams, the direct-sum total tensor of complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], its right unit isomorphism, and the canonical pullback identification of the degree-zero ring. Assume the tower derived categories and the countable products needed below exist. Normalized strict derived-limit data consist of a functor $L:D(\operatorname{Tow}(A))\to D(A)$, its universal right-derived comparison with ordinary inverse limit, invertibility on K-injective complexes [def-pur-kinjective-complex], whole-diagram evaluation with its localization comparison, and natural product and connecting maps forming the Roos triangle [def-weil-derived-limit]. For an edge $e:Y\to X$ of the corner presentation, with additive module direct image, and such limit data at $X,Y$, normalized strict direct-image data consist of the ordinary and tower total right-derived direct images, their universal comparisons and K-injective computation properties, the evaluation isomorphism normalized on K-injective tower complexes, the ordinary limit/direct-image comparison fixed by the canonical limit-post map, and the derived isomorphism $L_X;R_e\cong R_e^{\operatorname{Tow}};L_Y$. Its normalization is the equality of the two composites of the ordinary comparison and the three derived comparison maps. The ordinary direct-image comparison is normalized by the module adjunction counit after the canonical derived pullback comparison. The abstract data records and their ringed-site specializations define precisely these data; no projection-formula theorem is assumed.
